author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam finally meets one of the finished General puppets from Wildwood! LAIKA Studios' stop-motion animator Dobrin Yanev tours Adam around the stage where he spent years animating the film's largest puppet, demonstrating how he manipulated its form and feathers to create the majestic soaring shots of Golden Eagle in flight!

Wildwood is in theaters now and tickets are available at: https://wildwoodmovie.com/
Adam Savage Meets the Stop-Motion Puppets of LAIKA Studios: https://youtu.be/9stm18DFD08
